content:
Grouping four ordering-table part numbers into four modes; wavelength triplets from the transmitter “Central Wavelength” rows (1310FP vs 1550FP); `tx_power_max_dbm` = -8 from launch power max (20 km); `standards_code` = G.957 per the Standard section (STM-1/OC-3 are applications, not separate modes).

```json
{
  "modes": [
    {
      "label": "1310nm FP 155Mbps 20km commercial temp (PPC)",
      "model": "L9-SC315501-20PPC",
      "wavelength_min_nm": 1270.0,
      "wavelength_max_nm": 1350.0,
      "wavelength_center_nm": 1310.0,
      "standards_code": "G.957",
      "tx_power_max_dbm": -8.0
    },
    {
      "label": "1550nm FP 155Mbps 20km commercial temp (PPC)",
      "model": "L9-SC553101-20PPC",
      "wavelength_min_nm": 1510.0,
      "wavelength_max_nm": 1590.0,
      "wavelength_center_nm": 1550.0,
      "standards_code": "G.957",
      "tx_power_max_dbm": -8.0
    },
    {
      "label": "1310nm FP 155Mbps 20km extended temp (PPI)",
      "model": "L9-SC315501-20PPI",
      "wavelength_min_nm": 1270.0,
      "wavelength_max_nm": 1350.0,
      "wavelength_center_nm": 1310.0,
      "standards_code": "G.957",
      "tx_power_max_dbm": -8.0
    },
    {
      "label": "1550nm FP 155Mbps 20km extended temp (PPI)",
      "model": "L9-SC553101-20PPI",
      "wavelength_min_nm": 1510.0,
      "wavelength_max_nm": 1590.0,
      "wavelength_center_nm": 1550.0,
      "standards_code": "G.957",
      "tx_power_max_dbm": -8.0
    }
  ]
}
```
